prompt: A six-axis industrial robotic arm with an orange housing and a black rubber vacuum gripper lifts a single white ceramic coffee mug from a stainless-steel conveyor belt. The mug dangles from the suction cup at the end effector, and the arm's joints are frozen mid-rotation. The factory floor behind is a blur of grey concrete, safety-yellow guard rails, and overhead LED panel lights.

A grey FANUC robotic arm extends its parallel-jaw gripper around a cardboard shipping box on a roller conveyor in a fulfillment warehouse. The gripper's rubber-padded fingers close on the box's edges, and the arm's cable harness trails along its upper arm. Tall metal shelving units stacked with brown parcels recede into the depth of the facility under flat industrial lighting.

A KUKA robotic arm in bright orange lowers a windshield into the frame of an unfinished sedan on an automotive assembly line. The glass is held by four suction cups on a crossbar end effector, and the arm's heavy base is bolted to the concrete floor. The car's bare metal body sits on a moving platform, and sparks from a nearby welding station flare in the background.

A compact tabletop cobot with a light-grey housing and blue accent rings places a tiny circuit board onto a PCB assembly tray with millimeter precision. The board is pinched in a two-finger adaptive gripper, and the tray holds rows of identical unpopulated boards. A magnification camera and a soldering station occupy the clean white workbench beside the arm.

A Universal Robots cobot with matte grey joints and a soft silicone finger gripper picks up a clear plastic cup of iced coffee from a café counter. The cup's condensation beads against the gripper's compliant pads, and the straw tilts slightly. The counter is stainless steel, and an espresso machine and a stack of paper cups fill the background under warm pendant lights.

A delta robot suspended from a ceiling mount sorts a single red apple from a moving conveyor of mixed fruit in a food-processing plant. The robot's three parallel arms converge on a suction-cup picker that lifts the apple clear of the belt. The stainless-steel conveyor and white-tiled walls gleam under harsh fluorescent light, and water mist from a nearby wash station hangs in the air.

A palletizing robot with a heavy-duty flat-plate gripper stacks a single sealed cardboard carton onto a wooden pallet in a cold-storage warehouse. The carton is mid-placement, the arm's wrist angled precisely, and frost clings to the pallet's slats. The warehouse stretches behind in rows of floor-to-ceiling racking under blue-white cold-storage lighting, and the robot's base is surrounded by a low metal safety fence.

An articulated robotic arm mounted on a mobile AGV base reaches into a metal shelving unit in a distribution center to retrieve a single yellow plastic tote. The arm's telescoping gripper clamps the tote's lip, and the AGV's LiDAR sensor glows faintly on its chassis. The aisle of identical shelving and stacked totes stretches into the distance under flat panel lights.

A spot-welding robotic arm presses its copper electrode tips against a single joint on an automotive door panel, a bright white-orange spark erupting at the contact point. The arm's thick cables and water-cooling hoses loop along its upper segment, and the bare steel panel is clamped in a fixture jig. The assembly line's other stations are out of focus in the dim, spark-lit background.

A robotic arm with a magnetic end effector lifts a single steel gear from a machining tray in a precision manufacturing cell. The gear's teeth are freshly milled and gleaming with cutting oil, and the magnet holds it flat against the tool head. The CNC machine's open door and the aluminium chip tray are visible beside the arm's base.

A cobot with a force-sensing wrist and a three-finger adaptive gripper delicately picks up a laboratory glass beaker from a chemical workstation. The beaker is half-filled with amber liquid, and the gripper's silicone fingertips apply minimal pressure on the glass rim. A fume hood, pipette rack, and digital scale occupy the stainless-steel bench behind the arm.

A high-speed robotic arm with a vacuum end effector lifts a single glass bottle from the end of a bottling line, the bottle freshly capped and labeled. The suction cup grips the bottle's shoulder, and the conveyor behind carries a blurred row of identical bottles. The bottling plant's stainless-steel machinery and overhead piping gleam under industrial strip lights.

A SCARA robotic arm inserts a single microchip into a socket on a test board in a semiconductor cleanroom. The chip is held in an ESD-safe vacuum nozzle at the arm's tip, and the socket's gold pins are visible beneath. The cleanroom's white walls, HEPA ceiling panels, and a technician in a bunny suit are out of focus behind a glass partition.

A collaborative robot arm with a camera-equipped wrist inspects a single smartphone screen on a quality-control conveyor, the screen illuminated with a test pattern of colored bars. The arm's integrated vision sensor hovers inches above the display, and the conveyor's black rubber belt and the inspection station's ring light frame the scene in clean whites and greys.

A lightweight robotic arm with a needle-gripper end effector picks up a single cut fabric panel from a sewing-station table in a garment factory. The fabric droops softly from the gripper's array of thin needles, and the cutting table's ruled surface and a bolt of denim are visible beside the arm. Overhead thread spools and fluorescent tubes fill the factory ceiling.

A robotic arm in a pharmaceutical cleanroom places a single vial of clear vaccine into a padded tray, the vial held vertically in a custom silicone cradle gripper. The tray is half-filled with identical vials, and the arm's white housing and stainless-steel joints match the sterile environment. An airlock door and a digital temperature display are visible on the wall behind.

A heavy-payload robotic arm on a construction site lifts a single concrete block from a pallet, its hydraulic gripper clamping the block's sides. Dust coats the arm's yellow-painted housing, and the block's rough grey surface is bright in the midday sun. A half-built brick wall and stacked rebar fill the open-air site behind.

A paint-spraying robotic arm applies a coat of glossy red to a single car hood panel mounted on a rotating fixture in a spray booth. A fine mist of paint fans from the atomizer nozzle at the arm's wrist, and the booth's white walls and filtered ceiling are tinged with overspray. The arm's protective sleeve is speckled with dried paint from previous runs.

A bin-picking robotic arm reaches into a jumbled plastic tote to retrieve a single shrink-wrapped product with its suction-cup gripper. The arm's wrist-mounted 3D camera scans the bin's cluttered contents, and a green laser line projects across the objects. The packing station's tape dispenser, empty mailer boxes, and shipping-label printer fill the workbench beside the tote.

A robotic harvesting arm mounted on a wheeled mobile platform extends between rows of strawberry plants in a greenhouse, its soft-touch gripper closing around a single ripe berry. The berry's red skin dimples gently under the gripper's silicone fingers, and the arm's vision sensor glows blue above the end effector. The greenhouse's polycarbonate panels and drip-irrigation lines stretch behind in warm, diffused daylight.
